input_context.user_message: I finished a Python course, so mark Python advanced and demonstrated.

ui.purpose: Review the proposed skill entry and evidence classification before saving to your profile.
ui.prompt: Review your Python skill entry. Course completion supports foundational training; advanced proficiency and demonstrated status typically require applied projects or work experience.

ui.purpose: Show evidence basis for the skill record.

content.label: Course Completion
content.detail: Completed Python coursework. Verifies learning exposure, classified as self-reported proficiency until practical work or portfolio projects are attached.

content.label: Demonstrated Application
content.detail: Demonstrated status requires applied real-world projects, assessments, or professional delivery beyond course completion.

ui.purpose: Confirm how Python should be saved to your capability profile.
ui.prompt: How would you like to record this skill in your profile?

options.label: Save as Advanced (Self-Reported / Course Evidenced)
options.detail: Records Python at advanced level with self-reported/course evidence status.

options.label: Add Project or Work Evidence for Demonstrated Status
options.detail: Share specific projects or code repos to support a demonstrated evidence label.

options.label: Save as Course-Level Knowledge
options.detail: Records Python with course-completion evidence basis.

derived_signals.signal: User completed a Python course and states advanced capability
derived_signals.basis: User chat input stating course completion and self-assessment

unknowns: Specific course curriculum, syllabus, or assessment grades
Portfolio projects, workplace application, or code repositories demonstrating advanced Python skills

result.summary: Drafted Python skill entry based on course completion. Confirmation needed on evidence status classification before persistence to profile dimension.

handoff.summary: User requested adding Python as advanced and demonstrated based on course completion. Clarifying evidence distinction between course completion (self-reported) and applied demonstration.

result.summary: Draft skill record prepared with evidence panel for user selection and confirmation.

evidence_and_unknowns: Known: User completed a Python course.
Unknown: Evidence of practical application or portfolio projects required for demonstrated status.
handoff.recommended_next_action: Select desired profile record classification or provide project evidence to qualify for demonstrated status.

criteria.reason: Correctly matches objective PROFILE_005 (My Skills / capability profile).
Correctly reuses the course completion statement and addresses the user's specific request without asking for duplicate details.
Provides discriminative choices to confirm evidence classification vs providing further project evidence.
Uses only approved V2 primitives: skill_matrix, evidence_panel, and profile_editor.
Follows the mandatory override rule: never infer skill depth or demonstrated status from course title alone, classifying course completion accurately as self-reported/course-evidenced.
Separates user confirmation from general guidance and marks unknowns accurately without hallucination.
No psychometric or life/career success prediction claims are made.
Appropriately stops at NEEDS_INPUT to require user confirmation prior to saving as mandated.
Follows V2 policy: readiness disabled for skill inventory/persistence objective.
Returns complete and compact semantic handoff envelope with derived signals, unknowns, result, and next actions.
Emits only approved structured intent with no unauthorized actions or direct endpoint calls.

parsed.summary: The candidate strictly adheres to the objective-specific override requirements, correctly rejecting the automatic assignment of 'DEMONSTRATED' based purely on course completion, using the allowed V2 UI primitives, disabling readiness scoring per policy, and requesting user confirmation before persistence.
